lines.en: label dormwar8:
scene warhotelarrival1
Myself and the rest of the girls who were present at the maid cafe show up at the hotel to find three of the people who {i}weren’t{/i} waiting around in the lobby.
lines.zh: 我和其余在女仆咖啡厅露过面的女生们来到酒店，找到了那三个{i}没{/i}在大堂里等着的人。

lines.en: We proceed to make fun of them for being antisocial, rap hating buzzkills and then take their lunch money to go buy cigarettes and other cool kid stuff.
lines.zh: 我们接着狠狠嘲笑她们不合群、讨厌说唱又扫兴，然后抢走她们的午饭钱去买香烟之类的酷小孩玩意儿。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: We do approach them, though.
lines.zh: 不过我们确实走了过去。

lines.en: Well, {i}I{/i} approach them.
lines.zh: 好吧，是{i}我{/i}走了过去。

lines.en: The rest of the girls hurry into an elevator and pile up inside of it, probably breaking some sort of occupant capacity rule in the process.
lines.zh: 其余的女生急匆匆挤进电梯，一堆人叠在里面，大概顺手就破了某种载客上限规定。

lines.en: The elevator breaks and everyone dies, making the second floor victorious by default because they have more people left alive.
lines.zh: 然后电梯故障，全员身亡，二楼因为活下来的人更多而不战而胜。

lines.en: Just kidding again.
lines.zh: 又开玩笑的。

lines.en: I don’t know why, but I am feeling particularly ferocious right now.
lines.zh: 不知道为什么，我现在心情出奇地凶暴。

lines.en: : Oh, good. You’re here.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。你来了。

lines.en: : Please make yourself useful and carry the rest of my luggage upstairs when you have a moment.
lines.zh: : 麻烦你发挥点作用，等会儿把我剩下的行李搬上楼去。

lines.en: : No.
: But...how will it get up the stairs if-
lines.zh: : 可是……那它怎么上楼呢，如果——

lines.en: : Why even bring luggage? Aren’t we only going to be here for one night?
lines.zh: : 为什么要带行李？我们不是只在这里住一晚吗？

lines.en: : Two, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实是两晚。

lines.en: : We'll be staying over on Sunday as well since there is no[school] on Monday.
lines.zh: : 周一没有[school]，所以我们星期天也要在这里住一晚。

lines.en: : I tried to tell Touka to pack lightly due to how many people we'd have coming, but her mother apparently wouldn’t let her stay at the hotel unless she packed literally everything ever.
lines.zh: : 我试过劝 Touka 少带点，毕竟这次来的人多，可她妈妈显然非要她把几乎全部家当都塞进箱子，才肯让她住酒店。

lines.en: : The hell is she going to do with five bags over the course of two nights?
lines.zh: : 五个箱子，两个晚上，她到底打算拿来干什么？

lines.en: : Should we really be judging Touka’s mom for her weird hotel standards when she’s the one paying for the place?
lines.zh: : 这地方可是人家妈妈掏的钱，我们真该嘲笑她对酒店的奇怪标准吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But I can’t help but say I’m a little surprised she was okay with you coming here since I'm the only “chaperone.”
lines.zh: : 大概不该。不过我还是忍不住想说，她是放心让你来的这点让我有点意外——毕竟我是唯一的“监护人”。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival3
: She would have been okay with it regardless of whether a chaperone was present or not.
lines.zh: : 不管有没有监护人在场，她都会答应的。

lines.en: : This hotel is just one of many that falls under the umbrella my family holds over Kumon-mi’s hospitality industry, so we’re not put out at all by the three rooms we’re taking up tonight.
lines.zh: : 这家酒店不过是我家在 Kumon-mi 服务业版图下的产业之一，所以今晚开三间房对我们来说根本不算什么。

lines.en: : Granted, we wouldn’t be put out at all even if we had to rent them out, but that is beside the point.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，就算要我们自己掏钱租房，我们也完全不在意——不过这不是重点。

lines.en: : Yes, you are very rich. We know.
lines.zh: : 对，你家很有钱。我们都知道。

lines.en: : Noriko and I will help you carry your things since Sensei is too “busy” to be bothered with such a difficult, labor intensive undertaking.
lines.zh: : 既然 Sensei “忙”得抽不开身，不愿被这种又难又费体力的活儿打扰，那我和 Noriko 来帮你搬吧。

lines.en: : I can always count on you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto，我永远可以指望你。

lines.en: : So, why the third room?
lines.zh: : 那么，为什么是三间房？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival4
: Well, surely you didn’t expect all twenty of us girls to fit into one, did you?
lines.zh: : 你总不会指望我们二十个女生挤在一间里吧？

lines.en: : No, but I did expect one of me to fit into either of the ones that you guys are sleeping in.
lines.zh: : 不指望，但我本来以为我这一个人，总能塞进你们住的任意一间。

lines.en: : That seems entirely inappropriate and I would very much appreciate you sleeping elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 那听起来实在太不合适了，我还是非常希望你睡到别处去。

lines.en: : Do you not remember the grand prize of this dorm war, Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka，你不记得这次宿舍大战的大奖是什么了吗？

lines.en: : There is a prize? What is the prize?
lines.zh: : 有奖品吗？是什么奖品？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival5
: The winning floor gets to keep Sensei in their room during our trip to the beach.
lines.zh: : 赢了的那层楼，可以在我们去海边的时候把 Sensei 留在她们房间里。

lines.en: : And...that’s a thing people actually {i}want{/i} to compete over?
lines.zh: : 而……大家真的{i}会{/i}为了这种事争个你死我活？

lines.en: : Would you be more interested in competing over me if I helped carry your bags?
lines.zh: : 那要是我帮你搬行李，你会不会更有兴趣来争一争我？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival6
: Yes, actually. You’ve done nothing that would make me want to sleep in the same room as you thus far.
lines.zh: : 说实话，会的。到目前为止，你没做过任何让我想跟你睡一间房的事。

lines.en: : In fact, the only sleep-related experience I have with you involves you making fun of my completely normal, circular bed.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我跟你之间唯一跟睡觉有关的经历，就是你嘲笑我那张再正常不过的圆形床。

lines.en: : I volunteer to stay in Sensei’s room and-
lines.zh: : 我自愿去 Sensei 的房间陪他——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Then I would like to suggest that Sensei sleeps with the second floor girls and-
lines.zh: : 那我建议让 Sensei 去二楼女生那边睡——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Thank you for trying, Noriko. But Makoto wouldn’t let something like that happen on her watch.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的好意，Noriko。不过有 Makoto 盯着，这种事不可能发生。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’d be fine with it if it was just you two in a room and not {i}me{/i} with you instead.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，如果只是你们两个人待一间房，而不是{i}我{/i}跟你待一间，她就不会有意见。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival7
: I’ve essentially been Sensei’s personal secretary for as long as I’ve known him. The two of us staying in one room would be nothing short of professional.
lines.zh: : 从我认识 Sensei 起，我基本上就是他的私人秘书。我们两个住一间房，完全是公事公办。

lines.en: scene nightskysepia
I faintly recall a time just like that in the recent past.
lines.zh: 我隐约记起前不久也有过一段这样的时光。

lines.en: The wind was cold, the skies were bright-
lines.zh: 风很冷，天很亮——

lines.en: But alas, those times were fleeting.
lines.zh: 可叹，那样的时光转瞬即逝。

lines.en: Just like condoms in the sand...
lines.zh: 就像沙滩上的避孕套……

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival7
: If it were {i}you{/i}, though...
lines.zh: : 不过，如果是{i}你{/i}的话……

lines.en: : What, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 什么，Makoto？

lines.en: : Tell me what would happen if it were me.
lines.zh: : 你倒是说说，如果是我的话会怎么样。

lines.en: : I’ve had plenty of sleepovers with Sensei in the past and we’ve never done anything weird.
lines.zh: : 我以前跟 Sensei 一起过夜的次数多了去了，我们也从没做过什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: : And how many of those sleepovers began with you giving him a sedative?
lines.zh: : 那其中有多少次，是你先给他下了镇静剂才开始的？

lines.en: : I am very lost right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在完全跟不上你们在说什么。

lines.en: : As you should be. But hey, at least you’re being included in something.
lines.zh: : 跟不上才对。不过嘿，至少你被算进来了。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival8
: Have you been feeling a little left out cause of how new you are or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是因为自己还是新人，觉得有点被冷落了？

lines.en: : Well...I’d be lying if I said I didn’t think being new was at least part of it. But it is nice getting to be around all of you in a more...casual setting.
lines.zh: : 嗯……要说“新人”这件事完全没关系，那是撒谎。不过能像这样在更……随意的场合跟你们待在一起，挺不错的。

lines.en: : I just hope that whatever transpires tomorrow doesn’t become yet another obstacle in currying favor with all of you.
lines.zh: : 我只希望明天发生的那些事，不会又变成我讨好你们的一道障碍。

lines.en: : What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 这话什么意思？

lines.en: : What’s Touka’s competition supposed to be?
lines.zh: : Touka 要参加的项目到底是什么？

lines.en: : Deadly. Now, please retire to your room for the night so that we may all-
lines.zh: : 要命的那种。好了，请回房休息吧，好让我们大家——

lines.en: : Nah. I’m going to go say hi to everyone in both of the rooms.
lines.zh: : 不。我要去两个房间跟所有人都打个招呼。

lines.en: : There is really no need for you to-
lines.zh: : 你真的没必要——

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival9
: We’re in Room 24, the first floor girls are in Room 25, and you’re in-
lines.zh: : 我们在 24 号房，一楼的女生在 25 号房，而你在——

lines.en: : Room 23?
: No. You’re down the hall in Room 44. I can see why you would have guessed that, though.
lines.zh: : 不是。你在走廊另一头的 44 号房。不过我能理解你为什么会这么猜。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, okay then.
lines.zh: : 呃，那好吧。

lines.en: scene black
I grab one of Touka’s bags to bring upstairs because manual labor is my middle name and start to head over to the elevator.
lines.zh: 我拎起 Touka 的一个箱子准备搬上楼去——毕竟“体力活”就是我的中间名——然后朝电梯走去。

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei. You’re forgetting these-
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei。你忘了这些——

lines.en: : Good luck being a normal girl, Touka.
lines.zh: : 祝你做个正常的女孩，Touka。

lines.en: : And Noriko.
lines.zh: : Noriko 也是。

lines.en: : And Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto 也是。

lines.en: : Actually, you’re all pretty weird.
lines.zh: : 说真的，你们都挺怪的。

lines.en: : Anyway, see you tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 总之，明天见。

lines.en: I ride the elevator up to the second floor.
lines.zh: 我坐电梯上二楼。

lines.en: I could have probably just taken the stairs, but...it would have been really hard on account of this entire...single bag that I have.
lines.zh: 其实走楼梯也行，但是……考虑到我手上这整整……一个箱子，那实在太难了。

lines.en: Sidenote: I hope Ami was smart enough to pack literally anything for me, because I don’t even have my phone charger right now.
lines.zh: 顺便一提：希望 Ami 够聪明，好歹替我收拾了点什么，因为我连手机充电器都没有。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival10
: Oh, hey! Look who it is!
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿！看看这是谁来了！

lines.en: I drop Touka’s bag at the door because I get tired of carrying it and figure this is close enough.
lines.zh: 我拎累了，把 Touka 的箱子往门口一扔，觉得放这儿也够近了。

lines.en: : Hey. This is certainly an interesting combination of girls.
lines.zh: : 嘿。这组合可真有意思。

lines.en: : Sana and I were just talking about her thing tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我刚在跟 Sana 聊她明天的项目。

lines.en: : I was offering to help her with her hair, but it seems like she doesn’t really want to do anything special with it.
lines.zh: : 我说要帮她弄头发，但她好像不太想做什么特别的造型。

lines.en: : So...Sana’s competition involves hair in some way?
lines.zh: : 所以……Sana 的项目跟头发有关？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival11
: I’m...sorry in advance for...disappointing you...
lines.zh: : 我……先说声对不起，我大概会让你……失望……

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You’re being too hard on yourself. You know we all think you’re adorable, right?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。你对自己太严格了。你明知道我们都觉得你很可爱，对吧？

lines.en: : Not...really.
lines.zh: : 不……太知道。

lines.en: : I don’t really talk to most of you...so...there would be no way for me to...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我跟你们大部分人都不怎么说话……所以……我没法……嗯。

lines.en: : So...what is this contest exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……这比赛到底是什么？

lines.en: : A...nightmare.
lines.zh: : 一场……噩梦。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival12
: I still don’t know if we’re allowed to tell you beforehand, but we’ve all kinda made an unspoken agreement to just...not say anything, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我还不确定我们能不能提前告诉你，不过大家好像都心照不宣地……决定什么都不说吧？

lines.en: : So you’ll just find out tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 所以你明天就知道了。

lines.en: : But if you vote for Sana, it would make me reaaaaaally happy~
lines.zh: : 不过你要是投给 Sana，我会非——常开心的~

lines.en: : And how would {i}you{/i} feel, Sana?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}什么感觉，Sana？

lines.en: : Uhh...embarrassed?
lines.zh: : 呃……难为情？

lines.en: : That is not a winning attitude, [young]lady.
lines.zh: : 这可不是获胜者该有的态度，[young]小姐。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival13
: I...I know that! But...I...
lines.zh: : 我……我知道！可是……我……

lines.en: : I kind of...don’t want you to see me like that, so...
lines.zh: : 我有点……不太想让你看到我那个样子，所以……

lines.en: : Hey! You’ll do great! Just keep your chin up.
lines.zh: : 嘿！你一定没问题的！抬头挺胸就好。

lines.en: : At least you’re actually {i}trying{/i}, unlike a certain roommate of mine.
lines.zh: : 至少你是真的在{i}努力{/i}了，不像我那位室友。

lines.en: : All Yumi has to do to beat Io is just...cooperate.
lines.zh: : Yumi 要赢 Io，只需要……配合一下就行了。

lines.en: : Should be the easiest point ever, but nope!
lines.zh: : 本来该是史上最好拿的一分，结果才怪！

lines.en: : Wait, so...what are those two doing exactly?
lines.zh: : 等等，那她们俩到底要比什么？

lines.en: : Cooperating. That's the whole contest. Like, literally.
lines.zh: : 配合。比赛内容就是这个。真的，字面意义上的。

lines.en: : And...you're allowed to tell me about this contest, but not the other ones?
lines.zh: : 那……这个项目你可以告诉我，别的就不行？

lines.en: : Yeah, because this one is dumb and barely even a contest at all.
lines.zh: : 对啊，因为这个项目很蠢，根本算不上比赛。

lines.en: Okay, so...I guess I shouldn't really bother thinking about {i}that{/i} matchup just yet...
lines.zh: 好吧，所以……{i}那{/i}一场我大概暂时不用费心去想了……

lines.en: But, for my own personal reasons, I’m going to imagine Sana's is a nude photo shoot of some sort until proven otherwise.
lines.zh: 但出于我个人的理由，在有人拿出反证之前，我决定把 Sana 的项目想象成某种裸体写真拍摄。

lines.en: I mean, what else would she be so nervous about when she is a completely functional, highly social member of society?
lines.zh: 我是说，她明明是个完全正常、社交能力很强的人，还能有什么别的事让她紧张成这样？

lines.en: Do I think that would ever be approved by the council of [teens] that put this contest together? Probably not.
lines.zh: 我当然不觉得策划这场比赛的那群[teens]议会会通过这种方案。大概不会吧。

lines.en: But Noriko also almost gave me a handjob in front of two of her classmates this morning, so it’s not {i}impossible{/i} and still matches the context.
lines.zh: 但 Noriko 今天早上也差点当着两个同学的面给我打飞机，所以这也不是{i}不可能{/i}，而且很符合情境。

lines.en: Nude photo shoot it is.
lines.zh: 那就是裸体写真了。

lines.en: Good luck, Sana.
lines.zh: 祝你好运，Sana。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival14
I make my way over to Maya next for some reason.
lines.zh: 不知为何，我接着走向了 Maya。

lines.en: : What? Why now? I was about to lay down.
lines.zh: : 干嘛？为什么是现在？我正准备躺下呢。

lines.en: : Can I lay with you?
lines.zh: : 我能跟你一起躺吗？

lines.en: : No. Go away.
lines.zh: : 不行。走开。

lines.en: : Also, have you seen Ami anywhere?
lines.zh: : 另外，你有没有在哪儿看到 Ami？

lines.en: : Or...even Ayane, for that matter?
lines.zh: : 或者……哪怕是 Ayane 也行？

lines.en: : Not having either one of them here makes me look weird. Like I don’t have any friends or something.
lines.zh: : 她俩一个都不在，就显得我很怪。好像我一个朋友都没有似的。

lines.en: : I haven’t. But if you see Ami, can you ask her if she packed anything for me?
lines.zh: : 没看到。不过你要是见到 Ami，能帮我问问她有没有替我收拾东西吗？

lines.en: : What could {i}you{/i}, of all people, possibly need?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}这个人，能缺什么？

lines.en: : A phone charger would be nice. Can’t say I expected to be spending tonight in a hotel.
lines.zh: : 有个手机充电器就不错。我也没料到今晚会住酒店。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival15
: Well, it’s never too late for you to go home.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你现在回家也不算晚。

lines.en: : You’re essentially a dead opossum walking into a vultures’ nest right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 说到底，你现在就是一只死掉的负鼠，正走进秃鹫的巢里。

lines.en: : You know, you’ve said some strange things before, but that one really sticks out to me for some reason.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你以前也说过不少怪话，但这一句不知为何特别让我印象深刻。

lines.en: : Well, think about it. You’re the “prize” of this competition and you’re showing yourself in front of a bunch of people trying to “win” you.
lines.zh: : 你想想嘛。你是这场比赛的“奖品”，还主动跑到一群想“赢”你的人面前晃悠。

lines.en: : You do realize who you’re talking to, right? That is the ideal situation for me.
lines.zh: : 你知道你在跟谁说话吧？那对我来说可是最理想的状况。

lines.en: : Who knows? I barely understand anything anymore.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。我现在什么都不太明白了。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to have some fun before the next reset plunges Kumon-mi into the ocean or something and everything gets even weirder than it already is.
lines.zh: : 我只想在下次重置把 Kumon-mi 沉进海里之类的之前找点乐子，免得一切都变得比现在还要离谱。

lines.en: : Oooh, reset talk. Is it getting to be that time already?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，重置话题。已经快到那个时候了吗？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival16
: Why do you sound excited about that?
lines.zh: : 你听起来怎么还挺兴奋的？

lines.en: : Because it means I get to spend more quality time watching the stars with my favorite shrine maiden.
lines.zh: : 因为那意味着我能和我最喜欢的巫女一起，有更多时间看星星。

lines.en: : Can you just go find Ami, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能就去找 Ami，拜托了？

lines.en: : I’ll tell her you’re looking for her if I see her.
lines.zh: : 我要是见到她，会告诉她你在找她。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Also, just a word of advice, you should probably lock your door tonight.
lines.zh: : 还有，一句忠告：今晚你最好把门锁上。

lines.en: : Worried that Noriko is going to come get me?
lines.zh: : 担心 Noriko 半夜来找我？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival17
: Why would I ever worry about you?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会担心你啊？

lines.en: : You’ve actually been worrying about me a lot lately, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你最近其实挺担心我的，对吧？

lines.en: : Please leave. I don’t want to do this in a room full of people who I already need to constantly remind of how much I despise you.
lines.zh: : 请出去吧。我可不想在一屋子人面前演这一出——我都得不停地提醒他们我有多讨厌你。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. But only because you asked so politely.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。不过只是因为你这么客气地请我了。

lines.en: : Thank you. And goodnight.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。晚安。

lines.en: scene black
I quickly greet the rest of the girls in the room (Except for Yumi, who won’t even look at me) and make my way back into the hall.
lines.zh: 我迅速跟房间里其余的女生打了招呼（除了 Yumi，她连看都不看我一眼），然后走回走廊。

lines.en: I notice Makoto coming back as I do and she informs me that she’ll be going back to the dorm to hang out with Miku instead of staying here with everyone else tonight.
lines.zh: 就在这时我注意到 Makoto 回来了，她告诉我今晚她要回宿舍陪 Miku，不和大家一起住这儿。

lines.en: She also hands me the key that I forgot to take after meeting her in the lobby and then quickly disappears into her room to, presumably, pack her things and head home.
lines.zh: 她还把我刚才在大堂见她时忘拿的房卡递给我，然后迅速钻进自己房间，大概是去收拾东西准备回家了。

lines.en: Of course, I use that opportunity to sneak into the room of her enemy and see how they’re doing.
lines.zh: 当然，我趁机溜进了她对手的房间，看看她们那边怎么样。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival18
: At long last, the main course has arrived.
lines.zh: : 主菜终于上桌了。

lines.en: : Yes, that is me. Food.
lines.zh: : 对，就是我。食物本人。

lines.en: : I’m a little surprised to find you awake, Nodoka. I thought you came back to the hotel after your contest to take a nap or whatever.
lines.zh: : 有点意外你还醒着，Nodoka。我以为你比赛完回酒店是去补觉之类的。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. Accessing the part of my brain with all the fancy words can be quite exhausting.
lines.zh: : 是是是。调用脑子里装着那些高级词汇的部分，可是相当累人的。

lines.en: : But I’ll have you know that I got a full forty five minutes of sleep and am now ready to suggestively rub up against everyone in this room because “we’re just girls and no one will care.”
lines.zh: : 不过我得让你知道，我足足睡满了四十五分钟，现在正准备好跟这屋里每个人来点暧昧的蹭蹭——毕竟“我们都只是女孩子，没人会在意的”。

lines.en: : Would you like to join me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你要一起吗？

lines.en: : I would like nothing more, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我再乐意不过了，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Are you two secretly related or something?
lines.zh: : 你们俩该不会是亲戚什么的吧？

lines.en: : God I wish.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我倒是希望是。

lines.en: : Growing up alone was rather depressing at times.
lines.zh: : 一个人长大，有时候还挺抑郁的。

lines.en: : So, how does it feel knowing that yours is the only dorm room with two winners right now?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在你们是唯一一间出了两个获胜者的宿舍，感觉如何？

lines.en: : I mean...pretty normal, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……挺平常的吧，我觉得。

lines.en: : We both wound up in contests that like, perfectly play to our strengths, so I kind of expected this to happen.
lines.zh: : 我们俩碰上的比赛都完美对上各自的长处，所以我早料到会这样了。

lines.en: : It’s really depressing that your strength is not liking me.
lines.zh: : 你的长处是不喜欢我，这可真让人沮丧。

lines.en: : Depressing for you, maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许只是让你沮丧而已。

lines.en: : And I don’t {i}not{/i} like you. I just look at you as a...creepy adult male teacher.
lines.zh: : 而且我也{i}不是{/i}不喜欢你。我只是把你看成……一个让人毛骨悚然的成年男教师。

lines.en: : If it is any consolation, Sensei, those reasons are precisely {i}why{/i} I like you.
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果这能让你好受点的话——正是{i}因为{/i}这些，我才喜欢你。

lines.en: : How are you two even friends?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底是怎么成为朋友的？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival19
: That’s a good question. How {i}are{/i} we friends? Like, when did that even happen?
lines.zh: : 问得好。我们怎么会{i}是{/i}朋友来着？到底是什么时候的事？

lines.en: : Love works in mysterious ways, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 爱情的运行方式很神秘哦，Otoha。

lines.en: : Perhaps we’re simply drawn to each other like magnets?
lines.zh: : 也许我们就像磁石一样互相吸引？

lines.en: : Or perhaps, like a praying mantis, your pheromones have lured me to you and you’re just days away from biting my head off and feasting on my body?
lines.zh: : 或者，就像螳螂那样，是你的信息素把我引到你身边，而你就差几天就要咬掉我的头、大快朵颐我的身体了？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival20
: Yeah, so I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以我完全不知道。

lines.en: : But I do know that Noriko’s been looking for you.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实知道，Noriko 一直在找你。

lines.en: : Noriko? I just saw her downstairs.
lines.zh: : Noriko？我刚才还在楼下见过她。

lines.en: : Well she’s in the bedroom now and she’s looking for you again.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她现在在卧室里，又在找你了。

lines.en: : I guess that makes sense. She tends to search for me a lot.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。她总爱到处找我。

lines.en: : You two aren’t, like...you know.
lines.zh: : 你们俩该不会……那个吧。

lines.en: : Fucking each other?
lines.zh: : 睡过？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival21
: Dude.
lines.zh: : 哥们。

lines.en: : What? That’s what you were getting at, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你不就是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : Hi. I’m back and my interest is piqued.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我回来了，而且我的兴趣被勾起来了。

lines.en: : I’m also very upset about missing this morning’s imouto contest after hearing how close things came to getting {i}really{/i} exciting.
lines.zh: : 还有，听说今早的妹妹大赛差一点就变得特别精彩，我却没赶上，{i}真{/i}是气死我了。

lines.en: : You should volunteer for that one in the next dorm war, Nodoka. I feel like you’d be a good little sister.
lines.zh: : 下届宿舍大战你应该主动报名那个项目，Nodoka。我觉得你会是个很称职的妹妹。

lines.en: : Oh, I’d be {i}very{/i} good.
lines.zh: : 哦，我会{i}非常{/i}称职的。

lines.en: : Okaaaaaaay, well I’m gonna go scour the halls for a vending machine or something.
lines.zh: : 好————吧，那我去走廊上转转，找个自动贩卖机什么的。

lines.en: : Can I...come with you?
lines.zh: : 我能……跟你一起去吗？

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival22
: Oh, uhh...sure? If you want.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃……行吧？如果你要去的话。

lines.en: : Until we meet again, Sensei. Until we meet again.
lines.zh: : 后会有期，Sensei。后会有期。

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei is here? Sensei, where did you put my-
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei 在这里？Sensei，你把我的——放哪儿了？

lines.en: scene black
: Oh. Okay...I can just...go find it.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧……那我就……自己去找。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival23
: Ah! Onii-chan!
lines.zh: : 啊！哥哥！

lines.en: : Onii-chan! Welcome home!
lines.zh: : 哥哥！欢迎回家！

lines.en: : Onii...chan...
: An older brother sounds nice.
lines.zh: : 有个哥哥听起来不错。

lines.en: : Come here to spend some time with the future winners of the first dorm war?
lines.zh: : 是来找第一届宿舍大战的未来赢家们叙旧的吗？

lines.en: : At this rate, it’s definitely possible. Your team has taken the last three rounds.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头，很有可能。你们队已经连拿三轮了。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival24
: Of course we have. We’re a force to be reckoned with.
lines.zh: : 那当然。我们可是一股不可小觑的力量。

lines.en: : Just wait until tomorrow when we {i}really{/i} start getting this competition locked down.
lines.zh: : 等到明天，我们就把这场比赛{i}彻底{/i}钉死。

lines.en: : That’s right!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: if imoutoami == True:
: I may have dropped us the first round due to some of my tactics being a little...unusual, but I know the rest of the second floor girls can make up for me!
lines.zh: : 第一轮我可能因为一些战术有点……不寻常，拖了大家后腿，但我知道二楼其他女生一定能替我补回来！

lines.en: else:
: And with me winning the imouto contest, our lead is so big that it’s basically impossible for the other floor to catch up!
lines.zh: : 再加上我赢了妹妹大赛，我们的领先优势已经大到另一层楼基本追不上了！

lines.en: : Thank god for sedatives, right?!
lines.zh: : 多亏了镇静剂，对吧？！

lines.en: : No. I already told you that was bad. Don’t do that again.
lines.zh: : 不对。我说过了，那样不好。别再做了。

lines.en: : So, Sensei! Since you’re here, that must mean you’re joining our slumber party, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei！你都来了，肯定是要加入我们的睡衣派对吧？

lines.en: : Will someone show up to kick me out if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 要是我说好，会不会有人跑来把我轰出去？

lines.en: : From this floor? Doubt it.
lines.zh: : 这层楼的人？不太可能。

lines.en: : But if you decide to take your pants off, remember that you aren’t allowed to touch me!
lines.zh: : 不过你要是打算脱裤子，记住不许碰我！

lines.en: : I might be off duty right now, but Uta-chan’s morals and limitations carry over to coed slumber parties as well!
lines.zh: : 虽然我现在下班了，但 Uta 酱的道德准则和行为底线在男女混合睡衣派对上同样适用！

lines.en: : You may touch me as much as you like, wherever you like!
lines.zh: : 你想碰我多少就碰多少，想碰哪儿就碰哪儿！

lines.en: : You’re not going to get nervous again?
lines.zh: : 你不会再紧张了吧？

lines.en: : I’m nervous just thinking about it!
lines.zh: : 光是想想我就紧张了！

lines.en: : Touch me and you die.
lines.zh: : 碰我你就死。

lines.en: : I know, Tsuneyo. You don’t have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 我知道，Tsuneyo。这点你不用担心。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival25
: Tsunecchi, you can get a little closer, you know? You don’t have to sit all the way back there like some kind of loner.
lines.zh: : Tsunecchi，你可以再靠近一点啊？不用像个独行侠似的坐在最后面。

lines.en: : Like, I’m all up in Noriko’s bubble right now and she’s totally fine with it.
lines.zh: : 你看我现在都快贴上 Noriko 了，她一点都不介意。

lines.en: : I bet Sensei would like it, too. Wouldn’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我猜 Sensei 也会喜欢的。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : It is becoming more dangerous for me to remain standing up with each passing second.
lines.zh: : 我继续这么站着，每一秒都变得更危险。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I can not do that, Green Onion.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我做不到，青葱。

lines.en: : Whaaaaat? How come?
lines.zh: : 为————什么？为什么呀？

lines.en: : Because you both smell very nice and I would likely attempt to taste you.
lines.zh: : 因为你们俩闻起来都很好闻，我大概会忍不住想尝一口。

lines.en: : I am safer in the background.
lines.zh: : 我待在后面比较安全。

lines.en: : Okay, time to sit down.
lines.zh: : 好吧，该坐下了。

lines.en: I take a seat at the foot of the bed to conceal Tsuneyo’s (And probably Uta’s?) eyes from being seared by the sight of a growing erection.
lines.zh: 我在床尾坐下，免得 Tsuneyo（大概还有 Uta？）的眼睛被我渐渐抬头的那东西灼伤。

lines.en: I’m not worried about Noriko, obviously, since she has already felt it on multiple occasions now.
lines.zh: Noriko 我当然不担心，毕竟她已经摸过好几次了。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival26
: Hey, you haven’t seen Io by any chance, have you?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你该不会在哪儿见过 Io 吧？

lines.en: : We walked back from the rap battle together, but she disappeared the second she realized there were people already waiting in our room.
lines.zh: : 说唱比赛结束后我们一起走回来，可她一发现我们房间里已经有人在等，人就没影了。

lines.en: : She’s missing as well? That makes three total since Ayane and Ami are MIA too.
lines.zh: : 她也失踪了？加上 Ayane 和 Ami 也不见人影，那就是三个了。

lines.en: : Kirin too, I guess. But she’s probably just out for a walk or something. She does that a lot.
lines.zh: : 大概还得算上 Kirin。不过她可能只是出去散步什么的，她经常这样。

lines.en: : I’m sure they’ll all find their way back soon enough.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定她们很快就会自己回来的。

lines.en: : Maybe Io just went back to the dorm or something? That seems like an Io thing to do.
lines.zh: : 也许 Io 只是回宿舍了什么的？这种事挺像她会干的。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival27
: Not without telling me, but...I guess I’ve kinda been on her case all day.
lines.zh: : 她不会连招呼都不打就走，不过……我今天一整天确实有点盯她盯得紧。

lines.en: : She’s kinda like a pet snake that doesn’t like being handled or something.
lines.zh: : 她有点像那种不喜欢被人摆弄的宠物蛇。

lines.en: : Give her too much attention and it’ll just make her mad. Then, next thing you know, you’ve gotta have someone suck the venom out of your wound and it becomes a whole thing.
lines.zh: : 你太关注她，她就会生气。然后一不留神，你就得找人把伤口里的毒吸出来，事情就闹大了。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival28
: Snake venom...
lines.zh: : 蛇毒……

lines.en: : I still need to try that...and now I know where to get some.
lines.zh: : 我还没尝过那个呢……现在我知道上哪儿弄了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, didn’t we decide that snake venom ramen was a bad idea?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我们不是已经说好蛇毒拉面是个坏主意了吗？

lines.en: : Fuck you in the rude way and not the literal way that I have now discovered the meaning of.
lines.zh: : 去你的——是粗鲁的那种“去你的”，不是我现在才明白意思的那种字面意义上的。

lines.en: : Io doesn’t have real venom, Tsunecchi. She’s a human girl, just like you and me.
lines.zh: : Io 又没有真毒液，Tsunecchi。她跟你我一样，就是个普通的人类女孩。

lines.en: : What does it mean to be human, Green Onion?
lines.zh: : 何以为人呢，青葱？

lines.en: : {i}What does it mean to be?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}何以为“存在”呢？……{/i}

lines.en: : Okay, well I’m probably going to head over to my room now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我大概该回自己房间了。

lines.en: : Today was exhausting enough and if I am going to continue to be a completely unbiased and awesome judge, I need to get some rest.
lines.zh: : 今天已经够累的了，我要继续当一个完全公正又了不起的裁判，就得休息一下。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival29
: Good call, Sensei! Just keep doin’ what you’re doin’ since my girls are in the lead!
lines.zh: : 明智的决定，Sensei！我这边姑娘们正领先呢，你就照这样继续加油！

lines.en: : And hey, even if you do wanna be a {i}little{/i} biased, that’s okay. Just make sure it’s second floor bias and not first floor bias. You know?
lines.zh: : 还有嘿，就算你想稍微偏心{i}一点{/i}也没关系。只要偏的是二楼，别偏一楼就行。懂吧？

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’d offer to come hang out in your room with you, but I should probably give you some space on account of that whole drug thing, shouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我本来想说去你房间陪你，不过看在那件事——下药那件事的份上，大概还是该给你留点空间，对吧？

lines.en: : Probably. I still have to figure out how I feel about that.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。我还没想清楚自己到底是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Wanna just drug me next and make it an eye for an eye?
lines.zh: : 那下次换你给我下药，以眼还眼怎么样？

lines.en: : I would much prefer you to be conscious during our time together.
lines.zh: : 我更希望我们在一起的时候你是清醒的。

lines.en: : Are you suuuuuuure?
lines.zh: : 你确————定吗？

lines.en: : {i}Yes?{/i}
: Perhaps if the venom was cut with something citric like...lemon?
lines.zh: : 也许毒液该兑点柑橘类的东西，比如……柠檬？

lines.en: scene black
I exit the room of the second floor girls and follow the signs in the hall directing me toward my room.
lines.zh: 我走出二楼女生的房间，顺着走廊上的指示牌走向自己的房间。

lines.en: I’m not sure why mine has to be on the opposite end of the hotel, but I guess things will be a lot quieter that way.
lines.zh: 不知道为什么我的房间非得在酒店另一头，不过这样应该会安静很多。

lines.en: The girls were loud enough in both of their rooms that it was easy to hear what was going on in the other one through the walls.
lines.zh: 两个房间里的女生都够吵的，隔着墙都能轻松听见另一边在干什么。

lines.en: But I guess it was like that at the inn I went to with Chika as well and that was also owned by the Tsukiokas.
lines.zh: 不过我和 Chika 去的那家旅馆也一样，那家也是 Tsukioka 家的产业。

lines.en: Maybe cutting corners on thinner walls is just something they do to save money or something?
lines.zh: 也许把墙做薄点省成本，就是他们家的省钱之道？

lines.en: Who knows? I’m no rich person or financial genius.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢。我既不是有钱人，也不是金融天才。

lines.en: scene warhotelarrival30
But I {i}will{/i} graciously accept and benefit from their kindness or naivete.
lines.zh: 但我{i}会{/i}心怀感激地接受，并从她们的善意——或者天真——中获益。

lines.en: I’d never be able to afford three separate hotel rooms on my teacher’s salary.
lines.zh: 凭我当老师那点工资，我永远付不起三间酒店房。

lines.en: And it’s not like I can really ask for a raise either since I’m...you know.
lines.zh: 而且我也不太好开口要求加薪，毕竟我……你懂的。

lines.en: Really bad at my job.
lines.zh: 工作干得实在太烂。

lines.en: But I guess there would be no reason for me to ever go out of my way and get something like this in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我本来也没什么理由特意去搞出这样的场面。

lines.en: This is fun.
lines.zh: 这很有趣。

lines.en: It is.
lines.zh: 确实。

lines.en: But it’s not something a normal class would do.
lines.zh: 但这不是一个正常班级会做的事。

lines.en: And it’s probably not something I should be letting them do.
lines.zh: 而且大概也不该是我放任她们去做的事。

lines.en: But who cares?
lines.zh: 可谁在乎呢？

lines.en: Their lives belong to them and them only.
lines.zh: 她们的人生属于她们自己，只属于她们自己。

lines.en: And in letting them realize that, they’ve centered themselves around me.
lines.zh: 而在让她们明白这一点的过程中，她们把自己围绕在了我的周围。

lines.en: Each one of them is a celestial body orbiting around my existence.
lines.zh: 她们每个人都是绕着我的存在公转的天体。

lines.en: I am the center of the solar system.
lines.zh: 我就是太阳系的中心。

lines.en: I will take.
lines.zh: 我会夺取。

lines.en: And I will take.
lines.zh: 我会夺取。

lines.en: And I will take.
lines.zh: 我会夺取。

lines.en: And I will grow.
lines.zh: 然后我会成长。

lines.en: If life is nothing but a strange string of coincidences and being in places at the right time, I will be everywhere at once so that nothing is coincidental at all.
lines.zh: 如果人生不过是一连串奇怪的巧合、以及在正确的时间出现在正确的地方，那我就同时出现在所有地方，让一切都不再是巧合。

lines.en: Time is unlimited.
lines.zh: 时间是无限的。

lines.en: Until it’s not.
lines.zh: 直到它不再无限。

lines.en: But, right now-
lines.zh: 但，此刻——

lines.en: It is.
lines.zh: 它是无限的。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True and ayane_lust >= 15 and kirin_lust >= 15:
Which makes moments like this okay.
lines.zh: 所以像这样的时刻，也算无妨。

lines.en: $ dormwar8 = True
jump ayanelust15
else:

And since time is unlimited, no one will mind if I sleep.
